svg.title: 02 | EEG–Gaze Alignment and Paired-Window Quality
svg.desc: Observed six-person ZuCo 2.0 BIDS-relative alignment audit: 12 original EEG and EyeLink runs; 206 of 206 twelve-second windows satisfy finite x/y threshold 0.60. Train 95, Validation 31, Test 80. Short sub-YAK NR contributes one window. All drift_verified flags are false; neither eye calibration nor independent clock drift is demonstrated.

g.text: 12 ZuCo runs | 206 eligible windows | six people | clock drift not verified

g.aria-label: Schematic EEG recording and left-eye gaze acquisition

g.text: 206/206 windows pass finite x/y checks; gaze calibration and clock drift remain unverified.
Finite coordinates show source availability, not eye calibration or independently verified EEG–eye synchrony.
